summary: Create a PostgreSQL flexible server. Create a PostgreSQL flexible server with custom or default configuration. For more information for network configuration, see - Configure public access https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/postgresql/flexible-server/how-to-manage-firewall-cli - Configure private access https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/postgresql/flexible-server/how-to-manage-virtual-network- cli.

parameters.name: --admin-display-name
parameters.help: Display name of the Microsoft Entra administrator user or group.

parameters.name: --admin-object-id
parameters.help: The unique identifier of the Microsoft Entra administrator.

parameters.name: --admin-type
parameters.help: Type of the Microsoft Entra administrator.

parameters.name: --allow-same-zone
parameters.help: Allow primary and standby in the same zone when multi-zone capacity is unavailable.

parameters.name: --backup-federated-client-id
parameters.help: The client ID of the geo backup federated identity.

parameters.name: --backup-identity
parameters.help: The name or resource identifier of the geo backup user identity for data encryption. The identity needs to be in the same region as the backup region.

parameters.name: --backup-key
parameters.help: The resource identifier of the geo backup keyvault key for data encryption. The key needs to be in the same region as the backup region.

parameters.name: --backup-retention
parameters.help: The number of days a backup is retained. Range of 7 to 35 days. Default is 7 days.

parameters.name: --database-name
parameters.help: The default database name for an elastic cluster. Only applicable when --node-count is present.

parameters.name: --federated-client-id
parameters.help: The client ID of the federated identity.

parameters.name: --geo-redundant-backup
parameters.help: Whether or not geo redundant backup is enabled.

parameters.name: --identity
parameters.help: The name or resource identifier of the user assigned identity for data encryption.

parameters.name: --iops
parameters.help: Value of IOPS in (operations/sec) to be allocated for this server. This value can only be updated if flexible server is using Premium SSD v2 Disks.

parameters.name: --key
parameters.help: The resource identifier of the primary keyvault key for data encryption.

parameters.name: --location
parameters.help: Location. You can configure the default location using `az configure --defaults location=<location>`.

parameters.name: --microsoft-entra-auth
parameters.help: Whether Microsoft Entra authentication is enabled.

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: Name of the server. The name can contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and the hyphen (-) character. Minimum 3 characters and maximum 63 characters.

parameters.name: --node-count
parameters.help: The number of nodes for elastic cluster.

parameters.name: --password-auth
parameters.help: Whether password authentication is enabled.

parameters.name: --performance-tier
parameters.help: Performance tier of the server.

parameters.name: --private-dns-zone
parameters.help: This parameter only applies for a server with private access and is required when using --vnet or --subnet. The name or resource identifier of an existing private DNS zone. You can use a private DNS zone from the same resource group, a different resource group, or a different subscription. If you want to use a zone from a different resource group or subscription, please provide its resource identifier.

parameters.name: --public-access
parameters.help: Determines the public access. Enter single or range of IP addresses to be included in the allowed list of IPs. IP address ranges must be dash-separated and not contain any spaces. Specifying 0.0.0.0 allows public access from any resources deployed within Azure to access your server. Setting it to "None" sets the server in public access mode but does not create a firewall rule. Acceptable values are 'Disabled', 'Enabled', 'All', 'None','{startIP}' and '{startIP}-{destinationIP}' where startIP and destinationIP ranges from 0.0.0.0 to 255.255.255.255.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --sku-name
parameters.help: The name of the compute SKU. Follows the convention Standard_{VM name}. Examples: Standard_B1ms.

parameters.name: --standby-zone
parameters.help: The availability zone information of the standby server when high availability is enabled.

parameters.name: --storage-auto-grow
parameters.help: Enable or disable autogrow of the storage. Default value is Disabled.

parameters.name: --storage-size
parameters.help: The storage capacity of the server. Minimum is 32 GiB and max is 16 TiB.

parameters.name: --storage-type
parameters.help: Storage type for the server. Allowed values are Premium_LRS and PremiumV2_LRS. Default value is Premium_LRS. Must set --iops and --throughput if using PremiumV2_LRS.

parameters.name: --subnet
parameters.help: Name or identifier of an existing subnet. If you want to use a subnet from a different resource group or subscription, please provide its resource identifier instead of name.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.help: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value]...]. Use '' to clear existing tags.

parameters.name: --throughput
parameters.help: Storage throughput in (MB/sec) for the server. This value can only be updated if flexible server is using Premium SSD v2 Disks.

parameters.name: --tier
parameters.help: Compute tier of the server. Accepted values: Burstable, GeneralPurpose, MemoryOptimized.

parameters.name: --version
parameters.help: Server major version.

parameters.name: --vnet
parameters.help: Name or identifier of an existing virtual network. If you want to use a vnet from a different resource group or subscription, please provide a resource identifier. The name must be between 2 to 64 characters. The name must begin with a letter or number, end with a letter, number or underscore, and may contain only letters, numbers, underscores, periods, or hyphens.

parameters.name: --yes
parameters.help: Do not prompt for confirmation.

parameters.name: --zonal-resiliency
parameters.help: Enable or disable high availability feature.

parameters.name: --zone
parameters.help: Availability zone into which to provision the resource.

parameters.name: --admin-password
parameters.help: The password of the administrator. Minimum 8 characters and maximum 128 characters. Password must contain characters from three of the following categories: English uppercase letters, English lowercase letters, numbers, and non-alphanumeric characters.

parameters.name: --admin-user
parameters.help: Administrator username for the server. Once set, it cannot be changed.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
